target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  [ "$(grep -vc '^#' /tmp/sync243/spectral_gaps.csv 2>/dev/null)" -gt 0 ] && grep -q wrote /tmp/sync243/log 2>/dev/null && break
  sleep 20
done
echo "rows: $(grep -vc '^#' /tmp/sync243/spectral_gaps.csv 2>/dev/null)"
grep -v '^#' /tmp/sync243/spectral_gaps.csv 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$6!="trivial"{if($17>mx){mx=$17;mk=$7}} END{printf "Q=243 s=0 worst non-coboundary: gap_ratio=%.4f at k=%s -> kappa=%.4f (cf 0.0931 at Q<=81)\n",mx,mk,1-mx}'
